brief:
Israeli forces detained Al Jazeera journalist Montaser Nassar during military raids in the area near Hebron, Al Jazeera English reported. Details of the circumstances surrounding the detention and its duration were not immediately disclosed.

The arrest comes amid ongoing Israeli military operations in the West Bank. Al Jazeera has not yet issued a statement regarding the journalist's status or the reasons given by authorities for the detention.
dek: Al Jazeera journalist Montaser Nassar was detained in raids near Hebron.
title: Israel detains Al Jazeera journalist during Hebron raids
